newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas cash flow to finance spending.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas cash flow to finance spending.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Wednesday it expected to finance its capital expenditure programme through cash flow and that it expected to reduce the gearing on its balance sheet by five percentage points.

Qantas chairman Gary Pemberton told shareholders at the annual meeting that Qantas would spend A$430 million over the next three years on additional product development and a further A$280 million on terminal improvements.
"We expect that to come out of cash flow," Pemberton said.
Pemberton said the new expenditure would not put any pressure on the airline's cost-cutting programme and would not have a negative impact on the company's balance sheet.
"We expect to improve our gearing by another five percentage points this year," he said.
The company, which is 25 percent owned by British Airways Plc, had a gearing ratio of 61:39 at the end of the 1995/96 (July/June) financial year.
